confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are rough estimates from scattered, partly dated web sources (Expatistan Ushuaia pages last updated Feb 2025, a 2014 travel blog, and a 2026 guide with unclear methodology), and Argentine peso prices move quickly. Cappuccino and cocktail are bounded estimates; cocktail is set at roughly twice the beer anchor because direct evidence was weak. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context, not based on inspected booking pages or current listings. The FX observation may be stale: the rba.gov.au page snapshot is dated 20 March 2026, and I could not retrieve the latest F11 daily observation.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on Ushuaia's position as a seasonal, tourism-driven Patagonian gateway, with prices benchmarked against other Argentine Patagonian tourist towns such as Bariloche and El Calafate and adjusted upward for end-of-the-world tourist pricing. Food anchors draw on the Expatistan Ushuaia price pages, a 2026 guide quoting a mid-range meal for two at about $60 and a budget meal at about $25, and general budget-meal ranges of $10-30. Accommodation is a model estimate with no accommodation search performed.
